prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production battle arena background for Vaisgard RPG, landscape 4:3, 1280x960 composition.
Primary request: original richly detailed modern 16-bit pixel-art battle backdrop INSIDE the covered ancient stone irrigation canal of Edran. View at low oblique eye level across the broad DRY stone maintenance walkway, matching a JRPG combat scene; not the top-down exploration map.
Scene: enclosed underground room of wet grey-brown stone masonry. Along the BACK wall only is a narrow dark teal water channel behind a low heavy stone parapet. An old wooden sluice gate is OPEN, its heavy dark leaf lying flat against the rear wall above the water, never blocking the dry walkway. Moss and tiny damp highlights in masonry joints, restrained warm amber light from the left access passage. A dim enclosed ceiling or upper masonry fades into darkness, no open sky. Front three quarters of image are continuous broad dry worn stone paving suitable for two fighting actors. Excellent tactile stone and restrained readable pixel clusters, handcrafted late16-bit/modern indie RPG quality, luminous warm paving contrasted with dark teal water. Dense environmental craftsmanship but uncluttered combat space.
Composition: enemy actor will be overlaid near right middle and hero at left foreground in landscape; mobile crops the central vertical strip. Keep middle and foreground open dry paving, clear separation of actor silhouettes, background details concentrated at far wall and edges. Do not draw actors or cast actor-shaped shadows. No objects in the central combat positions.
Constraints: ONLY environment, no characters, creatures, portraits, weapons, people, UI, buttons, borders, text, numbers, logos, treasure, new mechanisms or secret doors. No forest, grass clearing, mountains, castle, daylight sky or outdoor setting. Match the already approved warm stone / teal water canal exploration art, with believable horizontal ground perspective. Opaque image.
